description: This Swift source file defines classes and enums related to managing a web chat UI within a macOS application. It includes a custom NSPanel subclass for key focus, an enum for presentation modes, and a singleton manager class for handling chat sessions and UI presentation logic.

classes.name: WebChatPanel
classes.description: A custom NSPanel subclass that can become key and main, used for hosting the web chat UI.

classes.name: WebChatPresentation
classes.description: An enum that defines how the web chat is presented, either as a window or an anchored panel.

classes.name: WebChatManager
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing web chat sessions, their UI presentation as windows or panels, and related state.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays a chat session in a window based on session key.

methods.name: togglePanel
methods.description: Toggles the display of the chat UI as an anchored panel or hides it.

methods.name: closePanel
methods.description: Closes the panel if it is open.

methods.name: preferredSessionKey
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves and caches the preferred session key from GatewayConnection.

methods.name: resetTunnels
methods.description: Closes and clears all chat session UI controllers and cached data.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Resets all chat sessions and UI elements.

methods.name: panelHidden
methods.description: Handles the event when the panel is hidden, invoking visibility change callback.
